messages:
ana: Planning a maintenance window for az28 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Scope: TOR NIC microcode + staggered GPU soft reboots. We'll use 4 cohorts (1 rack each), 9m gap. Expect some cold-kv reseed and brief enqueueing during backfill.

rick: Are dedicated pools in az28 at risk?

ana: No dedicated hosts expected to be touched. We will skip nodes with label dedicated=true. Only pool=shared-gpu-az28 in scope.

zoe: Runbook outline? I can take cohort C.

ana: TL;DR runbook:
- 01:30 UTC: push manifest PR (HPA min +1, PDB relax)
- 01:45 UTC: eu-canary preheat (1 rack) to validate kv hit-rate + routing fallback
- 02:00 UTC: cohort A cordon -> kvseed preheat -> drain after hit-rate >= 70% or 10m
- cohorts B/C/D staggered every 9m
- Routing: brief announce suppression per cohort swap; smart-routing will prefer fallback regions for new sessions.

mat t: typo in handle^^

matt: Cost question: if we need on-demand warmbackfill, what's the cap?

rick: Estimate: 2 racks warmbackfill for 1hr ~ $1.1k-$1.9k. Finance pre-approved contingency of $2.5k for infra maint this month. Tag billing with "az28-tor-nic".

zoe: Suggest pre-provisioning a 2-node local warmpool per cohort to reduce on-demand spend. We can protect them from preemption for the window.

ana: Good idea. We'll pre-provision warmpools and reserve until window ends. Also set HPA cooldown to 6m to avoid thrash.

matt: Rollback triggers?

ana: Abort and roll back if p95 > 250ms for 5m OR error rate increase > 2.5% sustained for 5m OR kv hit-rate doesn't reach 70% after 12m per cohort.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-245 created. Window: 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z - 2026-04-15T04:00:00Z. Pager: infra/eng-sre.

rick: I'll monitor billing and add the billing tag. Will also pre-authorize up to $2k emergency if warmpool can't hit targets.

zoe: I'll own canary validation and post kv hit-rate/p95 snapshots at each cohort boundary.

ana: Final checklist before 01:30 UTC: PR merged, warmpools provisioned, canary validated, billing tag in place. Ping @oncall on any tail latency drift. :rocket:
